_comment: Max first-load JavaScript per route, transferred kB (gzip over the wire), 375 px mobile viewport, cold cache, production build (npm run build && npx next start -p 3140; node scripts/measure-bundles.mjs). Next link PREFETCH traffic is aborted during measurement (scripts/perf-prefetch-filter.mjs) because it made the same build measure differently under different machine load; with it blocked the figures are identical run to run. Re-baselined 2026-11-08 from that deterministic measurement: each value is the measured figure plus 10%, EXCEPT where an older, tighter number already passed, which was kept (a ratchet only goes down: /workspace /intelligence /dashboard /qualify /developers /account /account/login). Lab bytes, not Core Web Vitals. Enforced by tests/site/perf-budget.test.ts against a live production server: by the `site` CI job on every pull request, and by hand with PERF_BASE_URL set. Lower a number when a route gets lighter; raise one only by a deliberate, reviewed edit. Tightened /workspace and /admin/reviews after the project panel's quotation section and evidence-ladder card became on-demand chunks (measured 227.2 and 182.3 kB before, 161.8 and 136.8 after; budgets were 222.2 and 164.6).
